result:
My "slow delegations" conclusion was confounded — every hang was actually the dependency *rebuild*, never reaching my step delegations! If I cache the hanging dep modules, Main may build fine. This is the key unblock. Let me build the hanging `Book1.Prop46.Main` with a large timeout — if it completes (or progresses), these modules are slow-not-infinite and I can grind through caching them.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
source ~/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; echo "===== Book1.Prop46.Main (3000s) ====="; /usr/bin/time -v timeout 3000 lake build Book1.Prop46.Main > /tmp/bp46b.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -aE "Elapsed" /tmp/bp46b.log | tail -1; echo "=== progress (last modules built/replayed) ==="; grep -aoE "\[[0-9]+/[0-9]+\] (Building|Replayed|Built) [A-Za-z0-9._]+" /tmp/bp46b.log | tail -6; echo ALLDONE
<<<END>>>
